title: Spatio-temporal dual-stage hypergraph MARL for human-centric multimodal corridor traffic signal control
abstract: arXiv:2602.17068v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Human-centric traffic signal control in corridor networks must increasingly account for multimodal travelers, particularly high-occupancy public transportation, rather than focusing solely on vehicle-centric performance. This paper proposes STDSH-MARL (Spatio-Temporal Dual-Stage Hypergraph based Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning), a multi-agent deep reinforcement learning framework that follows a centralized training and decentralized execution paradigm. The proposed method captures spatio-temporal dependencies through a novel dual-stage hypergraph attention mechanism that models interactions across both spatial and temporal hyperedges. In addition, a hybrid discrete action space is introduced to jointly determine the next signal phase configuration and its corresponding green duration, enabling more adaptive signal timing decisions. translated_title: 面向以人为本的多模态走廊交通信号控制的空间-时间双阶段超图多智能体强化学习
translated_abstract: 以人为本的走廊网络交通信号控制必须越来越多地考虑多模态出行者，尤其是高载客量的公共交通，而非仅关注以车辆为中心的性能。本文提出了STDSH-MARL（基于空间-时间双阶段超图的多智能体强化学习），一种遵循集中训练和分散执行范式的多智能体深度强化学习框架。该方法通过新颖的双阶段超图注意力机制捕获空间-时间依赖关系，该机制建模了空间和时间超边上的交互。此外，引入了一个混合离散动作空间，以联合确定下一信号相位配置及其对应的绿灯时长，从而实现更自适应的信号配时决策。在五种交通场景下的走廊网络实验表明，STDSH-MARL表现出优越性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于空间-时间双阶段超图的多智能体强化学习框架，通过双阶段超图注意力机制和混合离散动作空间，实现了对多模态走廊交通信号的自适应控制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a spatio-temporal dual-stage hypergraph-based multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that achieves adaptive corridor traffic signal control through dual-stage hypergraph attention and a hybrid discrete action space.
